verdict: WSUS server is unreachable from the client. Update scans cannot run until connectivity is restored.
fix: On the SUP server, confirm IIS is running and the WsusPool application pool is started (it commonly stops on memory pressure). From the client, test `Invoke-WebRequest http://<SUP>:8530/SimpleAuthWebService/SimpleAuth.asmx` to verify HTTP 200. If the response is 503, recycle the WsusPool and raise its private memory limit to 0.
